definitions.full: H2784. chartsubbah [ חַרְצֻבָּה ] noun [feminine] bond, fetter, pang , only plural חַרְצֻבּוֺת ; — 1 construct ׳ח רֶשַׁע Isa 58:6 bonds of wickedness i.e. imposed by wicked men (|| מוֺטָה אֲגֻדּוֺת ). 2 pangs (compare חֵבֶל חֶבֶל, ), absolute למותם ח ׳אֵין Psa 73:4 they have no pangs (read וגו תָּם ׳לָ֑מוֺ ). חַרְצַנִּים see sub. I. חרץ . above
